title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Fifty Thousand Pesos to Be Spent for Necessary Alterations, Repairs and Improvement to Public Buildings, Grounds and Equipment to Be Occupied And/Or Used By the Government of the Commonwealth of the Philippines.

text.en:
The sum of fifty thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby appropriated
out of the general funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to cover necessary expenses for
alterations, repairs and improvement to public buildings, grounds and buildings, etc. equipment to be occupied
and/or used by the Government of the Commonwealth of the Philippines.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 6, 1935.
